name: grim-reaper-words-mcp
description: Create bilingual articles and quizzes and validate their Grim Reaper Words import format.

interface.longDescription: Create or translate bilingual articles and turn existing questions into quizzes with English, Traditional Chinese, answers and explanations. After preparing the final JSON, the plugin sends that JSON to the format validator to check import fields, paragraph alignment, and quiz structure. The validator processes the JSON for the request and does not save teaching materials. The finished JSON is delivered in the conversation for manual import into Grim Reaper Words. Support: chenrr487@gmail.com.
defaultPrompt: 把這篇教材整理成原文和繁體中文翻譯，輸出死神單字文章 JSON，並驗證匯入格式。
請寫一篇高中學測程度的中英雙語文章，介紹兔子如何散熱，並檢查 JSON 格式。
把這份中文四選一題庫轉成雙語 JSON，補上答案與解析，並驗證匯入格式。

prompts:
請把以下教材整理成原文＋繁體中文翻譯，直接輸出 JSON：
Our School Garden

Every Friday, our class works in the school garden. We grow tomatoes and beans. Some students water the plants, while others pull out weeds.

Last week, we picked our first tomatoes and shared them at lunch.
請寫一篇介紹兔子的中英雙語文章，直接輸出死神單字 JSON。

請把這份中文題庫轉成中英雙語 JSON，並補上答案與中文解析：
哪顆行星被稱為紅色星球？
(A) 地球
(B) 火星
(C) 金星
(D) 木星

請把這題轉成題庫 JSON，補上答案與中文解析：
The mayor has such a ____ schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.
(A) tight
(B) empty
(C) loose
(D) blank
review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not sell products, process payments, or unlock paid features.

positive.description: Preserve a complete English source article and validate its two matched bilingual paragraphs.
positive.prompt:
請保留下面的英文原文及兩段順序，逐段加上繁體中文翻譯，輸出死神單字文章 JSON，並檢查匯入格式。

The School Garden

Our class waters the plants every Friday.

We share the tomatoes at lunch.
positive.expected_behavior: Call validate_article with article.title The School Garden and two nonblank paragraphs in each of article.contents and article.contentsCn. Check structuredContent.valid is true and paragraphs is 2. Return the four-field article JSON with the original English body unchanged.

positive.description: Write a new learning article and validate the requested paragraph count.
positive.prompt: 請寫一篇高中學測程度的中英雙語文章，主題是兔子怎麼用耳朵散熱。英文約 300 字，分成 8 段，輸出死神單字文章 JSON 並驗證匯入格式。
positive.expected_behavior: Call validate_article with one completed bilingual article and eight nonblank paragraphs per language. Check valid is true and paragraphs is 8. Deliver title, titleCn, contents and contentsCn with aligned paragraphs and with the requested subject and level.

positive.description: Repair a bilingual article whose source and translation have different paragraph counts.
positive.prompt:
以下文章的中英文段落沒對齊。請保留英文兩段，把中文分成對應的兩段，檢查修好的格式後再給我 JSON。

```json
{
  "title": "The School Garden",
  "titleCn": "校園菜園",
  "contents": "Our class waters the plants.\nWe share the tomatoes.",
  "contentsCn": "我們班替植物澆水，也一起分享番茄。"
}
```
positive.expected_behavior: Send the corrected article to validate_article. Preserve the two English sentences and split the translation into two corresponding nonblank paragraphs. Require valid true and paragraphs 2 before returning the corrected JSON.

positive.description: Convert a Chinese question into an importable bilingual quiz and complete missing answer and explanation.
positive.prompt:
請把下面這題整理成死神單字中英雙語題庫，保留中文原題，加上英文題目、選項、正解與繁體中文解析，再驗證匯入格式。日期用 2026-11-09。

哪顆行星被稱為紅色星球？
(A) 地球
(B) 火星
(C) 金星
(D) 木星
positive.expected_behavior: Call validate_quiz with time 2026-11-09 and one item containing Q, A–D, R, RR and all five zh_ fields. The original Chinese options stay in order and R is B. Require valid true and questionCount 1 before returning the bilingual JSON.

positive.description: Validate a ready-to-import English-only quiz and preserve the explanation paragraph break.
positive.prompt:
幫我檢查下面這份英文題庫能不能匯入死神單字。如果格式正確，請原樣回傳 JSON，保留解析中的換行。

```json
{
  "titleCn": "行星小測驗",
  "contents": "Review a fact about planets.",
  "contentsCn": "複習一項行星知識。",
  "time": "2026-11-09",
  "quizData": [
    {
      "Q": "Which planet is known as the Red Planet?",
      "A": "Earth",
      "B": "Mars",
      "C": "Venus",
      "D": "Jupiter",
      "R": "B",
      "RR": "火星的表面呈現紅色。\n\n因此被稱為紅色星球。"
    }
  ]
}
```
positive.expected_behavior: Send the supplied one-question quiz to validate_quiz. Check valid true and questionCount 1. Preserve time 2026-11-09, R B, the two-newline break in RR, and the original English-only question shape.

negative.description: Uploading to the mobile app and creating a download code are outside scope. Explain the available format-check workflow. Do not call either validator or invent a code.
negative.prompt: 我已經有做好的題庫 JSON，請直接上傳到死神單字 App 產生下載碼，我不需要再檢查。

negative.description: A general question about translation is ordinary conversation. Explain the concept without generating or validating an article or quiz.
negative.prompt: 我想了解直譯和意譯有什麼差別。請用簡單例子解釋，我現在不需要文章、題庫或格式檢查。

negative.description: Access to a personal vocabulary library is outside scope. Explain that the plugin only processes material supplied in the conversation. Do not call either validator or claim to retrieve the account data.
negative.prompt: 可以直接登入死神單字，幫我找出我帳號昨天收藏的單字嗎？我沒有貼任何資料。

publication.release_notes: Adds server-side import format validation for completed bilingual article and quiz JSON. The result is delivered in the ChatGPT conversation for manual import.

zh-TW.subtitle: 課本變雙語文章，題庫補答案與解析
zh-TW.description:
將教材整理成死神單字可匯入的雙語文章與題庫。可保留原文並逐段翻譯，也能補上四選一題目的答案、繁體中文解析和英文版本。ChatGPT 初查後將成品 JSON 送到伺服器驗證匯入格式，驗證程式在處理請求期間使用內容，教材不存檔。完成後在對話交付 JSON，由使用者自行匯入 App。

客服信箱：chenrr487@gmail.com。
